en.summary: Monster Hunter Wilds is Capcom's mainline entry in the Monster Hunter series, released February 28, 2025 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, casting players in the Research Commission as it explores the Forbidden Lands and investigates a threat called the White Wraith. Since launch, Capcom has kept the game updated with regular free Title Updates adding monsters, difficulty tiers, and quality-of-life improvements, alongside cross-promotional events with other Monster Hunter titles.

guideSections.title: Ascendance: The Paid Expansion
guideSections.description: Announced in June 2026, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance is a large-scale paid expansion planned for 2027, comparable in scope to Monster Hunter World's Iceborne or Rise's Sunbreak. It adds the Skybound Eyrie, a new region of floating sky islands, a Master Rank progression tier, returning Elder Dragons, and a new Boost Bracer combat mechanic.

guideSections.title: Free Title Updates & Nintendo Switch 2 Port
guideSections.description: Beyond Ascendance, Capcom has continued shipping free Title Updates with new and returning monsters (including the fan-favorite Lagiacrus) and Arch-Tempered variants for endgame hunters, and has confirmed a Nintendo Switch 2 version of Monster Hunter Wilds is in development.
